data.name: Korner 5
data.detailed_description:
Korner 5 is a fast-paced 5v5 online football game where each player controls only their own character. With an arcade approach, fast matches and a constant progression, it offers a direct, competitive and perfect experience to enjoy solo as well as with friends.

Form your team, master your position on the field and start competing in intense matches where coordination and decisive reflexes make the difference. Customize your football player, improve their stats and unlock skills to adapt them to your offensive or defensive style. Every game is an opportunity to advance in leagues, demonstrate your level and enjoy dynamic, agile and exciting football.

Main features

  • 5v5 online matches: Live fast paced encounters where each player controls a unique avatar, encouraging teamwork and communication.

  • Immediate arcade action: Intuitive controls, quick plays and matches designed to offer fun from the first second.

  • Player progression: Level up, upgrade key attributes, and unlock upgrades that directly influence the performance on the field.

  • Complete customization: Create your own footballer and adjust their appearance, preferred position and playing style.

  • Competitive and accessible: Participate in leagues, tournaments and global rankings, or just enjoy casual games.

  • Social game: Form teams with friends, train new moves and compete to reach the best positions.

  • Vibrant visual environment: Colorful stadiums, fluid animations and a dynamic aesthetic that reinforces the arcade spirit of the game.
